messages:
elaine_pm: quick sync — post-release triage for build 1.4.2. getting 3 distinct asks: recurring hallucination on customer prompts (:bug:), embedding cost spike for long texts, and a small UI confusion on the streaming toggle. need to decide what we push into the next patch vs backlog. what do folks think?

sophie_support: 3 customers reported hallucination as blocking (two enterprise, one PLG). they see wrong entity insertion ~10% on a high-precision prompt set. customers are asking for a quick fix or mitigation guidance.

mike_eng: looked at logs — seems like KV-cache boundary on warm starts plus tokenization mismatch occasionally triggers stale context. plausible quick mitigation: enforce cache invalidation on session boundary (cheap) vs long-term: refactor tokenizer alignment across model variants. quick mitigation should cut incidents ~80%.

ash_prod: tradeoffs: hallucination fix is P1 for customers but might slightly increase avg latency by ~5ms. embedding cost is P2 — affects spend but no customer block. UI streaming toggle is tiny UX regression (P3). I'd prioritize: 1) hallucination mitigation, 2) embedding perf follow-up, 3) UX patch. acceptance criteria for 1) = <2% hallucination rate on the failing prompt set + postmortem + customer comms.

devon_sre: if we do cache invalidation hotfix we should be careful with burst memory pressure. can do a canary rollout in region us-west-2 and monitor mem + 95p latency for 2 hours. happy to schedule hotfix tonight during low traffic window.

taylor_data: can instrument a regression test: run failing prompt set through staging model and diff outputs. I can own the eval and produce a small dashboard. also recommend a short A/B that checks cost delta for embeddings if we change batching.

mike_eng: plan proposal: branch hotfix -> cherry-pick fix into release branch, run CI, canary deploy to us-west-2 for 2 hours, then full rollout if stable. estimate: 4 devh to implement + 1 devh for tests + 2 hours canary. quick patch code sketch:
```
// pseudo
if (session.isWarmStart && tokenMismatch) {
  kvCache.invalidate(session.id);
}
```

elaine_pm: sounds good. who owns the patch and customer comms? Sophie can prep customer notes once we have canary result.

mike_eng: I'll own the patch. @devon_sre you'll own the canary and rollback plan?

devon_sre: yep. push to canary 21:00 PST, monitor: mem, 95p latency, error-rate. slack alert channel = #eng-oncall. rollback if error-rate > 0.5% above baseline.

sophie_support: I'll draft a short note to the 3 customers: what happened, mitigation steps, expected timeline, and offer 1:1 call. will share draft here for review. :email:

ash_prod: quick gating decision: hotfix goes to prod canary then prod. embedding work to be scoped by end of next sprint — assign to Taylor + Mike for perf analysis. streaming toggle UI: small PR to fix copy, scope to next minor.

deploy-bot: CI passed on hotfix branch (build 5348), tests: 124/124 green. artifact: rwd-inference/hotfix-5348

mike_eng: thanks — I'll start the patch now. will post PR link and estimated finish time in this thread.

elaine_pm: summary/action items:
- Mike: implement cache-invalidation hotfix and open PR (ETA ~6h)
- Devon: canary deploy 21:00 PST + monitor/rollback rules
- Taylor: run eval and provide dashboard for acceptance criteria
- Sophie: customer comms draft and outreach after canary
- Ash: scope embeddings perf follow-up for next sprint
Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to confirm rollout results and next steps. thanks everyone :rocket:
